verdict.rationale: In-person payments are a fair question for a payments platform for sellers, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions terminals, tap-to-pay SDKs, or in-person charges settling into connected-account balances. The cited material covers online charges, payouts, balances and onboarding only, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder with offline sellers, in-person works on the same stack — terminals or tap-to-pay SDKs that settle into the same seller balances and reporting as online payments
